description: Source code for a Python script 'api_leak_detector.py' that detects incorrect standard library uses in the Cobalt layer by analyzing unresolved symbols in binaries using 'nm'. It loads allowed symbols, ignores certain libraries, compares with a manifest, and outputs leak information or updates the manifest.

methods.name: DiffWithManifest
methods.description: Compares leaked symbols with a manifest to find newly introduced or removed leaks.

methods.name: FindLibraries
methods.description: Finds all static libraries in the build config directory, excluding ignored ones.

methods.name: FindLeakingSourceFiles
methods.description: Identifies source files that contain leaking symbols based on nm output.

methods.name: InversedKeys
methods.description: Swaps keys and inner keys in a nested dictionary.

methods.name: FindLeakLocations
methods.description: Finds static libraries and source files where leaked symbols are used.

methods.name: LoadAllowedC99Symbols
methods.description: Loads allowed C99 symbols from a file.

methods.name: LoadManifest
methods.description: Loads symbols from a manifest file.

methods.name: LoadLibrariesToIgnore
methods.description: Loads list of libraries to ignore from a file.

methods.name: PrettyPrint
methods.description: Prints data structures in a readable format.

methods.name: ProcessNmOutput
methods.description: Parses 'nm' command output to extract unresolved symbols.

methods.name: RunCommand
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command and returns its output.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the leak detection process based on command-line args.
